marks.gloss_en: ten mentions of kohen; one for the rule; the rest limitation-after-limitation, amplifying to nine Israelites and one kohen
consecrated land is assessed by nine [Israelites] and a kohen -- ten assessors
by that arithmetic say five kohanim and five Israelites -- the amplification fixes no split
השור יסקל וגם בעליו יומת -- as the owner's death (a court of twenty-three), so the ox's death
the ox to be stoned is judged by twenty-three
